consumer: An objective/mission threshold check asking 'does the avatar carry >=250 units of water_clean across reachable inventory?'
scope: The engine's own charge count of water_clean over the avatar's full reachable inventory (wielded/worn/inventory plus nested container contents), matched to the goal's >=250 threshold
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw per-item records (type_id, charges, count_by_charges, location) but never computes a water_clean total or the >=250 predicate, leaving summation and reach to the consumer
divergence: Avatar carries a sealed water bottle holding 300 charges of water_clean nested inside it: the engine's charges_of(water_clean) returns 300 (>=250 true), but a frontend summing only top-level item.charges sees the bottle's own charges (0) and reports false
